name: Tool Permission Guard
description: Sample plugin demonstrating before_tool_call and before_tools_resolve hooks for identity-based tool access control.

nonOwnerDenyTools.description: Tool names to deny for non-owner senders.

channelAllowMap.description: Per-channel tool allowlist. Keys are channel IDs, values are arrays of allowed tool names.

nonOwnerDenyTools.label: Non-owner denied tools
nonOwnerDenyTools.help: Tool names that non-owner senders cannot use (e.g. exec, gateway)

channelAllowMap.label: Per-channel tool allowlist
channelAllowMap.help: Map of channel ID to allowed tool names. If set, only these tools are available on that channel.
